title: Bigram lab
description: Measuring and tuning a counted bigram model in four small stations: the loss of a line from the training text against letter salad, the validation loss while the model reads more text, sampling temperature, and the V×V table behind the model.

stations.title: Read more text, be less surprised
The model is a V×V table

changelog: Second half of next-char-lab 2.1.0, split so that each simulator has at most seven stations (PEDAGOGY.md §5). English and German UI; every experiment starts with a prediction that is judged after the result (SIMULATOR-SPEC §7 rule 5); starts in focus mode with a progress row; canvas colours are resolved through a probe element (§4.5); full state is saved and restored.
